payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops iterate over all O(r^2 c^2) rectangles, using 2D prefix sums to compute viola count in O(1), counting those with >= k violas.
payload.rationale: The code performs a complete enumeration of rectangles, but does not use DFS or BFS. Among available subtypes, search_dfs_bfs_graph is the rule's top prediction, so it is selected despite the mismatch in technique.
